purpose: Evidence-backed recovery queue for historical media. Backup/export evidence and live/public source snapshots are reconciled without inventing URLs; canonical Current media remains in LOC_MEDIA_REGISTRY.json.
recovery_method: use backup/export JSON for historical completeness and asset evidence
use live/public source snapshots for current public URLs and fresh metadata
reconcile by stable platform ID first, then exact URL, then date + normalized text evidence
search lo3rwang Threads source text for Suno/share/media URLs when historical text is the available evidence
cross-match Suno share URL against Music song/version records
cross-match known IG/YouTube links against Music media links and LOC_MEDIA_REGISTRY
promote to Current media only when an actual media URL or explicit media evidence exists
otherwise retain as candidate/evidence and do not invent a Reel/MV link

source_scope.note: Live and backup sources coexist. Backup is the historical recovery layer; live/public snapshots supply freshness and presentation URLs. Platform source does not determine Scope ownership.

counts_scope: Historical lo3rwang media merge snapshot. These counts are recovery-operation evidence and must not be interpreted as the Current canonical media total.
governance_rule: lo3rwang-provided exact URLs and live-observed public URLs may become media evidence. Backup-only assets remain valid historical evidence even without a public permalink. Candidate/calculated URLs are not promoted until observed or verified; ambiguous matches remain unresolved.

primary_source.name: 影音連結整合清單
primary_source.rule: same song multiple Reels preserved; different song_id versions kept separate; blanks never guessed
